name: Anarch Thaumaturgical Rituals — 1 Basic — Banish Big Brother

system.description: This modern ritual lets a thaumaturge detect and potentially nullify technological eavesdropping — microphones, recorders, surveillance cameras and the like. In addition to normal ritual requirements, the caster and any participants must completely burn a captured representation of themselves (a photo or voice recording) and sprinkle the ashes over themselves. Until the next sunrise, recipients feel a buzzing sensation at the back of the neck whenever they are recorded or monitored by such a device, sensing its general nature (listening, watching, recording) and approximate relative location, though not who is operating it. Once aware, the recipient may spend a Mental Trait to disable the device for the rest of the scene; simple technology malfunctions automatically, while complex or remote systems may require a Mental Test (retest Security). Magical or sentient devices cannot be disabled this way, though the thaumaturge remains aware of them.
